tmp:2350: kibbelu ha-Torah — Israel's act of receiving the Torah at Sinai, possible only after casting away speculative wisdoms
tmp:2351: hishlikhu me'itam kol ha-chokhmot — the act of casting away all secular/philosophical wisdoms, Israel's precondition for receiving the Torah at Sinai
tmp:2354: tefillat Hashem — prayer of/for God, an aspect of the state 'before Creation' (ayin), whereby one praying for another is answered first
tmp:2355: kedushah — holiness as such, symbolized by the letter Yud (the 'tenth'/tithe), drawn down into Malkhut
tmp:2356: hatchalat ha-makom she-mishtalshel mi-sham ha-mamon — the supernal point of origin from which money devolves down the chain of worlds, itself pure holiness
tmp:2357: kedushah ve-shefa kodesh — holiness and holy abundance, the sacred flow at money's root before it materializes below
tmp:2359: tzvi la-tzaddik (Isa. 24:16) — the verse-phrase 'beauty/glory for the righteous,' expounded as the sanctity of marital union of the tzaddik
tmp:2360: kedushat ha-zivvug — the holiness of marital union/coupling, the tzaddik's sanctified sexuality (razin d'razin)
tmp:2361: kedushat Yom Tov — the holiness of the festival day, which the tzaddik embodies and which one senses by attachment to him
tmp:2362: kedushat Yisrael am kadosh — the intrinsic holiness of Israel the holy nation, the 'illuminated faces' (anpin nehirin) rooted beyond all traits and desires
tmp:2363: vayarek (Gen. 14:14, 'he armed') — the verse-word expounded as the green line (kav ha-yarok) drawn from Binah, linked to Abraham's chesed
tmp:2364: kav ha-yarok — the kabbalistic 'green line' extending from Binah that encircles the entire world
tmp:2365: hon (Prov. 29:3, 'wealth') — the verse-word expounded as voice (kol), via 'honor God me-honkha = mi-gronkha' (from your throat)
tmp:2367: kol ha-yotzei me-ha-kaneh — the voice issuing from the windpipe (kaneh/reed), rooted in fear/gevurot, symbolized by Gabriel's reed planted in the sea
tmp:2368: karna — the Aramaic 'horn' (of the donkey, in the Talmudic tale), expounded as the voice of the rebuker (mokhiach) that severs Malkhut from the cry
tmp:2370: shemu'ah tovah (Prov. 25:25) — 'good tidings from a far land,' expounded as the thunder-voice that heals the soul's distance from glory, like cold water on a weary soul
tmp:2371: kol ha-re'amim — the voice of the thunders, which 'announce themselves in goodness' and repair the soul's estrangement, reviving soul and bones
tmp:2372: perutah — the smallest coin (of charity), expounded via 'perita sifvateih' as the cooing voice of the turtledove (kol ha-tor)
tmp:2373: kol ha-tor (Song 2:12) — the voice of the turtledove, likened by the Sages to the crier-bird whose lips split (perita), linked to the perutah of charity
tmp:2375: kol neginah — the voice of melody/music, a form of holy boldness equated with teruah and shofar ('play well with teruah')
tmp:2376: mi she-yesh bo yir'ah — the one who possesses fear of Heaven, whose forceful voice becomes thunder that awakens the heart
tmp:2377: kolo na'aseh re'amim — the transformation of a person's voice into thunders: speech striking the brain/mochin so the heart is aroused ('voice awakens kavvanah')
tmp:2378: she-kol mah she-noten tzedakah le-yoter anashim — giving charity to ever more people, the practice that multiplies friends and purifies the air
tmp:2379: koneh lo re'im yoter — acquiring more friends/loved ones, the soul-gathering effect of widespread charity (Munbaz: 'I stored up souls')
tmp:2380: korei et ha-chiyyut le-tokh ha-yamim ve-ha-middot — calling/summoning the life-force into the days and attributes via the Name (Torah), since a name bounds a thing's vitality
tmp:2381: korin et ha-arikhut yamim — 'calling' length of days by the Name: invoking the Life of life through Torah (God's Name) to draw down life and longevity
tmp:2382: ezov — hyssop, the lowly plant of purification, symbol of the 'small of stature' (ketanei komah)
tmp:2383: ketanei komah — those of 'small stature': people whose refined intellect exceeds their good deeds, so their heart cannot contain their mind
tmp:2384: kiyyumo shel ha-da'at — the sustaining/endurance of da'at (knowledge), maintained through the Patriarchs = Chesed, Gevurah, Tiferet
tmp:2385: sechok — mockery/laughter (hit'alalti = 'I mocked'), the mimicry of the kelipot which ape holiness like a monkey imitating a man
tmp:2386: ta'avot — bodily desires/lusts, defined as superfluities (motarot) and hence kelipot, husks around the fruit of the body's true needs
tmp:2387: shochad (Deut. 16:19) — the bribe that 'blinds the eyes of the wise,' emblem of corrupted judgment producing alien thoughts in prayer
tmp:2388: ye'avver — the verb 'blinds' (from 'a bribe blinds the eyes of the wise'), the blinding of the eyes/judgment that spawns alien thoughts
tmp:2389: or ha-pashut ha-ba mile'eil — the undifferentiated simple light descending from Above, 'closed and concealed' (kamitz u-setim) until shaped by the receiving vessel
tmp:2390: kamitz u-setim — Zoharic term 'clenched and sealed': the closed, concealed state of the supernal simple light before it is configured in a vessel
tmp:2391: kamatz — the vowel-point kamatz, symbol of that which is clenched/closed and hidden (kamatz u-setim), linked to concealed supernal mochin
tmp:2392: kamatz u-setim — 'clenched and sealed,' the concealment-state signified by the kamatz vowel: hidden supernal light closed off from disclosure
tmp:2393: hirhurim ra'im — evil/lustful ruminations of the mind, identified as the 'reed (kaneh) of the Sitra Achra' that leavens the brain
tmp:2394: kaneh de-sitra achra — the 'reed of the Other Side' (chayat kaneh, Ps. 68:31): the demonic windpipe/reed embodied in evil thoughts, whose chet must be broken into heh (chametz→matzah)
tmp:2395: suf — the word 'Suf' (as in Yam Suf, Sea of Reeds), expounded as ketz kol basar, 'the end of all flesh' — the terminus/end-point
